For millennia, we believed an unseen divine power recorded our every deed for a final judgment. Today, algorithms and AI cameras have built a secular equivalent: the Digital Panopticon. When states hold the power to watch, score, and judge everything, they risk playing God. Are we trading our freedom for safety?
